amount_required.help: An entry must carry an amount; a class priced by its bands alone (piece units) need not.

payable_after_exit.help: Entries of this class may fall after the employment ends (non-compete pay, instalments of a separation payment) and are paid on a payslip of their own period.

raise_on_exit.help: The final slip raises this class itself when its eligibility holds on the exit (termination benefit, severance, notice in lieu), priced by its bands on an empty entry of the exit day; an entry of the class HR makes instead wins. A moved or undone exit takes it back.

amount.help: The class's bands price this amount; a REVERSAL takes back an earlier award.

facts.help: Payroll inputs required by the selected ad hoc item.

quantity.help: Units awarded, for a class priced per unit rather than in full.

amount.help: CEL amount over the payslip context; `allowance.amount` is the contract’s monthly figure.

amount_required.help: An entry must carry an amount; a class priced by its bands alone (piece units) need not.

on_exceed.help: BLOCK pays up to the limit, ALLOW pays all; either flags the excess on the run.

window.help: What the limit meters: each claim alone (default), or the settlement period or calendar year less the claims of the class already taken in it.

facts.help: Payroll inputs required by the selected claim item.

incurred_on.help: When the cost was incurred. The entry day is used when unset.

quantity.help: Units claimed, for a class priced per unit rather than in full.

before.help: The prior values of the fields the last update changed, recorded for the duties that answer a change.

engagement.help: PAYEE: a person paid without employment (a consultant, a commission agent): paid through entries only, outside the headcount and separations.

signed_contract_end.help: The planned end of a fixed-term contract; an early exit keeps it, so undoing the exit reopens to it.

anonymised_at.help: When the former employee was anonymised after the retention period; personal fields are blank since.

before.help: The prior values of the fields the last update changed, recorded for the duties that answer a change.

citizenship.help: The child’s citizenship as the governing version’s records compare it (e.g. CITIZEN).

nationality.help: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (for example SG). Jurisdiction rules compare it as a code.

before.help: The prior values of the fields the last update changed, recorded for the duties that answer a change.

facts.help: The entity facts the jurisdiction's entity input schema declares.

late_arrival_team.help: The team handle late-arrival reminders go to (`late_arrival_notice`); an entity naming none sends none.

pay_cutoff_day.help: The day attendance closes: 1 attends the calendar month; 2–28 attend from the previous month’s cutoff through the day before this one.

pay_frequency.help: The frequency the entity pays at from its start; a later switch is a `pay_frequency_changes` row.

pay_frequency_changes.help: Each switch of pay frequency, from its first day: a past period always reads the frequency then in force.

time_zone.help: The zone this entity's payroll windows and rostered days are counted in.

validation_severity.help: How the jurisdiction's validations and statutory guards bind this entity: a rule's own override (by its code), else `default`; `record` keeps the rule's own kind. Absent keeps every rule's own kind.

kind.help: A kind the version governing the day lists (`rule_set` PAYROLL `holiday_kinds`): what the work and leave records price it as.

can_encash.help: Whether untaken days of the class may be paid out. Stated on every class: no default decides it.

encash_at_window_end.help: On the last day of the class’s window (a calendar or service year), its untaken balance is encashed as on exit.

carry_depth.help: Required with carry_forward: how many windows carried days may still be carried (1: once).

carry_forward.help: CEL on the previous window: the most unused days carried into the next CALENDAR_YEAR or SERVICE_YEAR window; absent carries nothing.

consumes_after_days.help: With consumes_code: the first N units of the class (in the pool’s window) are its own; only those past N draw on the pool.

days.help: CEL entitlement in days over `service_months`, `bands`, `as_of`, the subject roots and `taken`; absent means the class is not metered.

hours_per_day.help: With consumes_code and a non-day unit: CEL over the subject, the units one pool day holds.

overdraw.help: CEL over `service_months`, `as_of` and the subject roots: the most days the balance may run below zero (advance leave). Required with days.

service_year_offset_months.help: SERVICE_YEAR: months after the employment start the first service year begins.

window.help: The span the balance is metered over; absent means LIFETIME. EVENT meters each entry.facts.event_id (or window_key) on its own; ROLLING the window_months ending on the day read.

window_key.help: CEL over `entry` (the movement’s columns and facts) naming the EVENT window a movement counts in, e.g. `entry.facts.child_id`; absent means entry.facts.event_id.

window_months.help: ROLLING (required): the months the window reaches back from the day read (that day included). On any class, the span of its taken.rolling root, which only a class stating it has.

share_by.help: How a leave row spanning pay periods is shared between them.

unit.help: What a request charges: DAY the planned working days of its range (rest and off days and published holidays charge nothing), CALENDAR_DAY every day of it, HOUR the scheduled hours of its planned working days.

unplanned_days.help: What a DAY request charges over a range with no planned shift at all: EVERY_DAY_BUT_HOLIDAYS every day of it less published holidays, REFUSE asks for the shifts to be planned first. Required on a DAY class.

amount.help: Cash for an encashment or an adjustment. Time off carries no amount.

days.help: Units the movement charges. A time-off range is counted by the write over the employment’s plan, in its class’s unit.

facts.help: Payroll inputs required by the selected leave item, such as the event whose leave balance is used.

from.help: First day of the period this movement covers. The entry day is used when unset.

half_day_end.help: The last day is the first half of that day.

half_day_start.help: The first day is the second half of that day.

amount_required.help: An entry must carry an amount; a class priced by its bands alone (piece units) need not.

advance_made_on.help: The actual advance date, where the jurisdiction uses it for repayment timing or an emergency-payment deadline.

facts.help: Loan inputs the selected loan class reads as entry.facts (for example a permitted advance purpose or a written agreement).

principal_amount.help: The principal actually lent. Leave unknown legacy principal amounts blank.

repayment_frequency.help: The cadence used when recalculating the editable repayment schedule.

repayment_period.help: The first and last permitted repayment dates. Both are required for a configured loan.

currency.help: The payroll currency of the version that raised it; the amounts are in it.

occurrence_key.help: The duty and the run that raised it; one obligation per occurrence.

trigger_ref.help: The payroll run that raised it.

bank_charges.help: The bank fee the company pays for this employee’s payment, in the payslip currency. Enter 0 if none; leave blank until confirmed. This does not change employee pay or statutory contributions.

company_payments.help: Amounts the company settles outside employee net pay. The salary report uses the jurisdiction’s payment classification to distinguish cash payments from tax-only information.

occurrence_key.help: The duty and its occurrence; one task per occurrence.

subject_collection.help: The collection of the row that triggered the duty.

approved_overtime_intervals.help: The exact approved overtime windows and their documented unpaid break duration, when separately recorded. Attendance must fall inside these windows, net of their breaks, and remains limited by the approved overtime duration. Blank runs on after the configured shift where the version’s `payroll.attendance.overtime_window` is AFTER_SHIFT, and credits no overtime otherwise.

banked_overtime_band.help: The overtime band (rate code) the banked hours were earned in.

banked_overtime_hours.help: Of the day’s overtime, the hours the employee elected to bank as time off instead of pay.

planned_overtime_hours.help: The overtime duration approved alongside the shift code. Only this duration can be paid as overtime, limited by actual attendance and rounded to the governing version’s attendance step. Blank means no approved overtime.

rules.help: Authoritative family data, ordered entries and digest-keyed executable programs. No jurisdiction fallback supplies regulatory policy.

source_identity.help: Original jurisdiction/source location and hash plus retained source IDs. Newly authored native identity never impersonates a retired source row.

day_type.help: WORK: a working day; REST: the weekly rest day; OFF: a non-working day that is not the rest day.

configuration.help: Original legal policy plus executable input, record, derivation, assessment and finalization configuration. Missing source evidence never establishes zero liability.

on_current_excess.help: This month's earlier slips already exceed the reconciled month charge: REFUSE stops for review, SETTLE credits the excess on this slip.

on_original_error.help: An earlier month paid less than its own original assessment: REFUSE stops for review, CATCH_UP lets on_underpaid settle it.

on_overpaid.help: Earlier months paid more than the recalculated liability: WARN keeps this month and warns (refund outside payroll), REFUSE stops for review.

on_underpaid.help: Earlier months paid less than the recalculated liability: CATCH_UP adds the shortfall to this month, REFUSE stops for review.

assessable.help: The month-to-date assessable amount of each wage part (ceilings, projections), CEL over `wage`, `month`, `year`, `period` and `terms`. A part without an expression is assessed as paid.

carry_uncovered.help: The employee share net cannot cover is advanced and recovered later: `advance` is CEL over `carry.short` (what net lacks) and `carry.share` (the scheme’s employee share), `recover` CEL over `carry.owed` (outstanding) and `carry.left` (what this slip’s net leaves).

person.help: Person facts this scheme reads, each a CEL expression over the statutory context (for example the age basis), merged into `person`.

refuse_when.help: Guards evaluated before the rules: the first that holds refuses the payslip with its message.

denominator.help: CEL: the divisor a prorated line states on the payslip. Required when `prorated`.

eligibility.help: CEL predicate over the payslip context; the line is produced only when it holds.

prorated.help: The line is the contract amount scaled to the days employed; the payslip records its proration.

quantity.help: CEL quantity over the payslip context.

rate.help: CEL rate over the payslip context.

employment_ids.help: Only these employments; empty for everyone at the entity or worksite.

kind.help: A code of the governing version’s suspension_kinds rule.

worksite.help: Only this worksite (the roster day’s, else the terms’ worksite fact); blank for the whole entity.

before.help: The prior values of the fields the last update changed, recorded for the duties that answer a change.

kind.help: A code of the governing version’s case_kinds rule.
